items.title: Claude Duet gains remote control of Claude Code sessions from phone
facts: Claude Duet can now control Claude Code that's running on your computer.
You can control Claude Code running on multiple computers, work on existing sessions, and spin up new sessions.
It supports real-time voice with Claude Code.

items.title: Cursor adds real-time voice chat with coding agents powered by Grok Voice
facts: You can now talk with your agents in a realtime voice call.
Voice chat works in the Agents Window, the IDE, on web, and in Cursor for iOS.
Voice chat runs on Grok Voice.

items.title: Developers mixing Claude Code and Codex in shared setups
facts: Developers are mixing Claude Code and Codex instead of picking one today.
A poll asks how people split the work: one plans and one codes, switch when a limit hits, run the same task in both, or something else.

items.title: Developer shares detailed AGENTS.md to reduce AI comment slop
facts: Do not write comments unless they are absolutely necessary to explain some very complex business logic or used as an input for tools to read and act on.
The point of this rule is to keep out AI slop comments. AI writes way too many and way too verbose comments.

items.title: Community shares multi-model Claude Code setup with Sonnet, Haiku, and Opus advisor
facts: Run Sonnet 5.5 for the session and writes the code, Haiku 5.5 explores files and docs in parallel, Opus 5.5 stays on call as advisor for the big calls.
Opus only steps in at three moments: before a plan locks, when the same error shows up twice, and before calling it done.

items.title: Anthropic engineer shares playbook for managing coding agents like a team
facts: Anthropic engineer Addy Osmani shared how to run AI coding agents like a team without babysitting every session.
It shows how to give agents context, verify their work, set guardrails and decide what ships: context → plan → delegate → verify → decide.

items.title: OpenAI acquiring Pierre Computer Company to integrate code storage into Codex
facts: OpenAI announced November 4 it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, the startup behind Code Storage and the open-source Trees and Diffs libraries that already render file browsing and change review inside the Codex app.
The plan, once the deal closes: fold Code Storage into Codex, so the agent that writes your code also has somewhere to keep it.

items.title: Advice against treating AI coding agents like junior developers
facts: Don't slow down your agents. Don't treat them like junior devs. Approving every small step.
My agents still don't push code. They plan, write, file issues and ask questions. A human decides what ships.
